name: Classic Novel
_note: 5.25 x 8in, the standard Indian and international trade paperback novel size. EB Garamond because it has genuine old-style figures and real small caps, both of which a novel's front matter needs and most free faces fake badly. Licensed OFL, so it can ship with the product and be embedded in customer PDFs without a per-book licence — check this for every face you add, it is the constraint that will kill half your font shortlist.
_measure: Text block is 99.35mm wide. At 11pt EB Garamond that is roughly 60 characters per line — inside the 55-65 range where a novel reads without effort.

vars._first-line: Small caps on the opening line rather than a drop cap. Drop caps in Paged.js (initial-letter) render inconsistently and a novel does not need one; the small-cap opening is the older and quieter convention.
